title: The long beat
rule: Five of eight panels are given to E5: the same pose with minimal changes while the errand drains away.
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p57_long_beat.py (plate, figures, balloons: build/p29_one_fixed_lens.py, build/p07_two_panels.py; brush: build/brushkit.py; figure model: build/b1m2.py)

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: page 29's HANDMADE brush plate of the office (page 07's plate geometry, the dab-chain brush of moins-dun-quart-de-seconde-pour-vivre), printed in all eight panels
top tier: three tall crops of the full plate for E0 (desk, memo, 4:09), E1+E2 (question at the window, answer under the clock at 4:10) and E3 (thanks; he heads for the cupboard)
below: five identical letterbox strips of one plate band (clock, agent's head, open cupboard with the ANRC 1922 key tagged SERVICE, the SERVICE door), numbered '1 of 5' ... '5 of 5' on pasted slips

between the five strips only: the minute hand 4:11-4:15, the pencil climbing to the chin (elbow 12->140 deg), the head sinking 0->9 deg, and a brushed thought balloon losing the errand word by word ('the key... the SERVICE door... at 4:15...' -> 'the key... the SERVICE...' -> 'the... the...?'), then the spoken forgetting line, then an empty thought
closing slip: '4:15. The key stays on its hook. The SERVICE door stays shut.'; brushed balloons with the four canon lines in the shared pen hand; hand-ruled borders

events.E1: P2: question balloon from the stranger at the window
events.E2: P2: under the clock at 4:10, answer balloon
events.E3: P3: thanks balloon; he walks toward the cupboard
events.E4: strip 1 of 5: the cupboard open, the key on its hook tagged SERVICE, the errand still in his thought
events.E5: strips 1-5: the same pose held 4:11-4:15; the errand drains from the thought balloon; strip 4 the forgetting line; strip 5 silence, key on its hook, SERVICE door shut

substitutions: none: the four lines verbatim; added thought balloons carry the draining errand
beat: the errand drains: strip after strip is added, the same pose, the minute hand advancing and the pencil rising while the thought balloon empties word by word, until the forgetting line and then an empty thought
beat_frames: b06: strip 4 with the forgetting line

self_check.five_near_identical_panels: five equal 1980x333 strips of the same plate band, numbered 1-5 of 5
self_check.outcome: key on its hook, SERVICE door shut (picture and slip)
